label: winner or champion of
definition: Person, team or organization X wins award or competitive title/event Y.
scope_notes: Win, champion, winner and title paths define the coherent award/championship component, preserving the prior scope. Political office, organizational membership and travel are separate predicates; participation alone does not qualify. A clear win path is assessed as textual support without importing external outcome history.

facts.reason: Mr. Baker travels, is dispatched and has visits or a mission to Baghdad; none is an award or competitive title.
The argument Prevention of Nuclear War is explicitly described as an organization that wins the Nobel Peace Prize; other group-award paths corroborate it.
Cubs have explicit win-World-Series paths; playing and appearance paths alone would be insufficient but do not erase those wins.
Bill Clinton wins or enters the White House in the political-office sense; that is outside the selected award/championship predicate.
Yankees explicitly win the World Series and its title; loss and participation paths may concern other occurrences and are mixed evidence.
